technique_name: Write a story describing a life-changing decision
description: After months of contemplation, John finally decided it was time to take a leap of faith. He had been stuck in a rut for a long time, never feeling like he was able to take the next step in life. He knew he had the potential to do something more, and if he didn’t take the opportunity now, he may never get it again. Taking a deep breath, John began to make plans to leave his small hometown and move to the big city. He arranged a place to stay, a job, and started telling all his friends and family
